title: Chris Evans Discusses Doctor Doom's Mask in Avengers: Doomsday
excerpt:
Evans says Robert Downey Jr. wears Doom's mask throughout the film.
His comments do not definitively rule out an unmasking scene.
body_md:
Since Marvel announced Robert Downey Jr.'s return as Doctor Doom rather than Tony Stark, fans have debated whether the villain's familiar face will become a major revelation for the heroes of the MCU.

Speaking to Empire, Chris Evans said Downey wears a mask throughout the film. He praised his colleague's ability to communicate emotionally despite the difficulty of performing behind a mask.

The distinction between wearing a mask throughout a production and never revealing the actor's face in the finished film matters. Evans did not explicitly account for every shot or rule out a brief unmasking sequence.

Keeping the mask on is consistent with Victor von Doom's established comic-book appearance. Such a performance places greater emphasis on voice, physical movement and the eyes. Promotional footage featuring close-ups of Doom has already encouraged discussion of this approach.

Suggestions that Marvel might reserve an unmasking for Avengers: Secret Wars, or that Doom is connected to a variant of Tony Stark, remain speculation. Evans's comments do not officially establish either theory.
